page_title: HEI 2-0 UNI | Heidenheim v Union Berlin 11/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+3' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Alexander Schwolow easily deals with the threat.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
88' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well wide of the left post.
85' Substitution. Niklas Dorsch makes way for Luca Kerber (Heidenheim).
83' 2 - 0 Goal! Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.

83' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Alexander Schwolow thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
81' The attendance for today's match is 15000.
79' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
76' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Robert Hartmann didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
74' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aljoscha Kemlein trots off the pitch and is replaced by Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin).
73' The game has come to an end for Frans Kratzig. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Marnon Busch (Heidenheim).
73' Here is a change. Paul Wanner is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).
72' Here comes a substitution. Benedikt Gimber is given a rest as he is replaced by Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim).
71' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Kevin Muller easily deals with the threat.
69' Union Berlin have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
66' The game is interrupted now, Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jordan Siebatcheu will be replaced by Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin).
60' Steffen Baumgart decides to make a substitution. Benedict Hollerbach will be replaced by Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin).
60' Substitution. Janik Haberer did his best and is replaced by Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin).
57' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored!
56' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Kevin Muller easily deals with the threat.
53' The corner is swung in but Heidenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
52' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley well wide of the right post from inside the box.
50' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) is adjudged offside.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Steffen Baumgart probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Woo-Yeong Jeong. He is replaced by Tim Skarke (Union Berlin).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Handball by Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin).
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) is easily saved by Alexander Schwolow.
44' Good work from Heidenheim as they win a corner.

44' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the right side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Alexander Schwolow with a brilliant diving save!
41' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
40' Union Berlin failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
38' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) takes the free kick from the edge of the box and fires the ball goalwards. The goalkeeper can stay calm as the shot sails high over the bar.
37' Robert Hartmann shows a red card with no hesitation. Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) can have an early bath and think about his challenge.
35' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
28' Leo Scienza is being substituted because of an injury. Frank Schmidt sends Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) on the pitch.
26' Heidenheim fail to score from a corner as Alexander Schwolow (Union Berlin) leaps to collect the ball.
25' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Heidenheim will take a corner.
25' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
24' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) is able to continue to play.
22' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

22' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the middle of the goal. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Alexander Schwolow with a fabulous save.
21' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
21' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Heidenheim.
21' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.

17' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the left side of the target. The assist goes to Leo Scienza and the score changes to 1:0.
16' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
15' The ball goes behind for a corner. Union Berlin will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
12' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick inside the box and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
11' Union Berlin earn a corner.
11' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) strikes a volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.

9' A wonderful opportunity! Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) strikes from close range and hits the ball nicely towards the top of the net. However, Kevin Muller makes a great save as he anticipates the shot and manages to parry it onto the bar.
6' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Kevin Muller easily deals with the threat.
2' Robert Hartmann has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin).
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Union Berlin will take the kick-off.
Robert Hartmann is the one to supervise the game today.
